protocol.interpretation: The selector retains the 4.0 cutoff recorded in legacy_selector_relevance_threshold. This version reports the 15-study historical selection without a new selection run or additional studies. External API responses, cache state and metadata may change; they do not replace the current versioned snapshot exports.

current_source_retrieval.interpretation: This current source-retrieval overlay does not reapply selection or change the historical 15-study selection. Two reports (Sokkhey and Zeng) have no verifiable copy; 15 reports were assessed, the Imperatrice protocol was excluded, and 14 empirical reports have recovered text. Sokkhey remains only as a historical inclusion with its previous MMAT responses, not as a text verified in this review. Machine2019_007 remains the abstract-stage exclusion.

deduplication_audit.interpretation: The PRISMA duplicate total combines exact normalized DOI/URL removals (27) and separately documented same-report adjudications (2). The latter were discovered during post-hoc identity reconciliation and remain in their own ledger. Every confirmed duplicate is counted before screening, regardless of the legacy stage stored for that row.

candidate_audit.interpretation: The 23-record candidate universe is preserved as historical context: 16 operationally retained records plus seven manual overrides. The selection under the 4.0 cutoff remains historical; current source retrieval is reported separately as 2 reports not retrieved, 15 reports assessed, 14 empirical reports recovered, and 15 historical empirical studies. The 15-study selection retains Sokkhey without a verifiable copy. The historical selection is divided into 15 empirical studies, 1 record excluded after abstract screening, 1 historical full-text report not retrieved, and 1 protocol excluded after full-text assessment. These categories describe distinct stages; the preliminary list is not equivalent to the empirical included set or an additional PRISMA stage. The 15-study selection is historical and is not presented as the final corpus. The cutoff and the historical selection are unchanged; no new studies or selection rerun are incorporated.

manual_override_adjudication.interpretation: The ledger records evidence and proposed scope rationales for the persisted overrides; it does not replace supervisor adjudication.

manual_override_evidence_matrix.interpretation: The matrix records source-supported scope signals and required actions. It is evidence for adjudication, not a final inclusion or exclusion decision.

bibliography.separation_rule: The BibTeX inventory contains 18 records in the preliminary list; 15 remain in the historical empirical selection under the 4.0 cutoff. This version contains no new studies or selection rerun. Methodological, pedagogical, assessment and technical references are external to the pipeline study set and remain in the complete TCC bibliography.

current_mmat_qa.denominator_meaning: S1/S2 screening records; use category_appraised_rows for Q1-Q5 coverage
blocking_reasons: The empirical corpus retains 15 studies provisionally; all have preliminary screening and category-specific appraisals, including explicitly operational routes. These are not final design or eligibility decisions.
Studies 5 and 7 use an inferred category-3 route with allocation unknown; study 8 uses an explicitly adapted category-4 route for computational models.
The preliminary ledger must not be interpreted as a quality score or ranking.
Study 8 is one thesis/report with mathematical components; fractions reused across chapters must not be counted twice and seven-domain results are not mathematics-only estimates.
Only 14 of 15 empirical-core studies have externally reviewed full text recorded.
One shortlisted empirical record remains pending primary full text and is excluded from the MMAT denominator.

methodological_appraisal.interpretation: The MMAT ledger describes the historical selection under the 4.0 cutoff: S1/S2 screening for 15 studies and category-specific appraisal for 15; 15 records remain in the historical empirical selection. Studies 5 and 7 use an operational category-3 route, study 8 an adapted category-4 route, and study 14 a category-2 route with conflicting allocation reports. Distinct datasets within study 8 must not be combined or counted twice. Sokkhey remains only as a historical record without a verifiable source copy; its previous MMAT responses are not revalidated. Zeng is outside the 15-study selection and has no MMAT appraisal. The recorded appraisals remain preliminary.
